answer: Quadratic weight per funding cluster: keys whose first deposit traces to one source form a single 'garden', and that garden earns reward weight equal to the square root of its key count. A farm of 100 keys gets 10 shares, not 100, so the 100th key adds only ~0.05 of a share. Weakness: an operator seeds each key from a fresh exchange withdrawal, so no funding ripple links them. Fix: 3 random established graders also merge keys sharing an ASN 'knoll' or answer-text overlap above 0.8 into one garden before weighting.
